strong_support: B2 improves its seed in at least 2 of 3 workloads, is better or more sample-efficient than equal-budget B1 in at least 2 of 3 workloads, and runtime feedback avoids at least one LP-positive real-runtime-worse transition
partial_support: Some workloads show benefit, but workload sensitivity, random-policy overlap, or runtime noise limits the evidence
no_support: B2 consistently fails to improve seed or does not outperform the equal-budget B1 random baseline
interpretation: Descriptive Module 3C decision, not a statistical significance test or final paper benchmark
